critical_code_review_comments: P0 credential leak in training.js is the only blocking issue. Root cause: training content was authored assuming admin-only read audience, but training.js is loaded on the public Hub/login page (for the tile previews + lesson catalog), so bundler folds it into the public JS bundle. Mitigation: keep password guidance abstract in UI content; if you want a printable admin crib-sheet with real passwords, render it server-side behind X-Admin-Token on a dedicated /api/admin/crib-sheet endpoint.

rca of the issue: P0 credential leak RCA: Feature 'Lesson 9 — Safety Department access' was written with literal passwords in the lesson body text to teach MASCI supervisors about the 3-tier auth model. Authors did not realize training.js (which catalogs all lessons for the Training Hub landing page) gets bundled into the public JS served at the unauthenticated login route. Reproduction: (1) open https://backup-forensics.preview.emergentagent.com/, (2) view-source, find /static/js/bundle.js, (3) curl that URL, grep 'MASCI1982!' — match. Fix: remove real passwords from training.js/training_es.js lesson 9 body; replace with 'ask supervisor' or generic tier-name copy. If admins need the real passwords in training, render them server-side behind /api/admin/... — never ship them to the public bundle.
